main_body: A large round leafy bush or canopy blob, about 46x46 px, with a few small brown branch patches. It has no trunk and no visible base.
top_band: none: the column is leaf noise in light, mid and dark greens all the way down. There is no distinct horizontal top band, front-edge step or front face.
evidence: Reading a vertical column through the middle, the greens are mottled with no top band that gives way to a front face. The whole shape is one flat foliage mass seen from above, like a plan view. It has no trunk, no underside shadow and no south face. The reference trees show a canopy over a trunk with a lit top and a shaded lower front. This blob has neither, so it reads as a top-down slab and fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The leaf ramp has about 5 greens: bright lime, light, mid, dark and a deep teal-green. The outline is a dark teal-green, a tint of the neighbouring foliage and not neutral black. The texture is dense pixel-leaf clumping with no large flat fills, and the small brown twig patches add variety. It is flatter than the references in form, because the light and dark values are scattered noise and not grouped into lit-top and shaded-bottom clumps. Per-tile colour count is still similar to the references, so it holds up next to them as a bush.
